verdict.rationale: Replit's first-party docs describe turning a recurring job into a routine that runs on a schedule and reports back to the user, which directly matches the story. Background agent tasks add some support for unattended work. The evidence is a single thin doc line with no detail and no hands-on or independent confirmation. Missing for 10: details on schedule configuration (cron or interval options), workflow scope and limits, run history and monitoring of routines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
